children: San Francisco Federal Reserve President Mary Daly on Thursday said she feels the central bank will likely need to raise interest rates further to deal with elevated inflation, but did not suggest it should be in a hurry about it.

"My bias is that further tightening will be needed," Daly said at the Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research, adding price pressures are spreading beyond energy and goods and into services, where inflation can be very sticky.
Higher bond yields "are most welcome," she said, and tighter financial conditions "gives us a little more time to make really calibrated decisions."
